meta.note: This file is the source of truth. Edit it in the repository and run `pnpm build` in DesignSystem/; edits made on the artifact page are replaced by the next publish.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-0
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Device and splash ground. Components never read the ramp directly.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-1
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Glass base and text on bone.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-2
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Solid chips on light artwork.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-3
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Marks and placeholder labels on the #bcbcbc placeholder.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-4
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Disabled text and inactive codes.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-5
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Quiet labels and units. Lightened from #6d7074 so quiet text holds 4.5:1 on ink-0 and ink-1.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-6
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Tertiary text and metadata.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-7
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Secondary text.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-8
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Body text in panels.

tokens.name: vcr-ink-9
tokens.usage: Raw ramp. Emphasised body and group headers.

tokens.name: vcr-bone
tokens.usage: The one emphasis colour: primary text, primary fill, focus ring, selection border. Inverts to ink in light.

tokens.name: vcr-bone-hover
tokens.usage: Bone under the pointer: primary button fill and hovered text. Only ever a hover state.

tokens.name: vcr-text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, values and rated categories on ground and glass.

tokens.name: vcr-text-strong
tokens.usage: Group headers, codes and button labels on ground and glass.

tokens.name: vcr-text-body
tokens.usage: Field labels and running text on ground and glass.

tokens.name: vcr-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Unselected tiles, notes and text buttons on ground and glass.

tokens.name: vcr-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata, hints and kbd hints on ground and glass. Light darkened from #6d7074 to hold 4.5:1 on the light ground.

tokens.name: vcr-text-quiet
tokens.usage: Units, prefixes and readout labels on ground and glass; the lowest step that still holds 4.5:1. Light darkened from #8d9094.

tokens.name: vcr-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and the inactive cell of a switch only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for information.

tokens.name: vcr-text-on-bone
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a bone fill: primary button, selected segment, solid tag, checked box.

tokens.name: vcr-text-segment-unselected
tokens.usage: Unselected segmented-control labels on glass and ground.

tokens.name: vcr-line-subtle
tokens.usage: Faintest hairline: grid ticks and inner rules.

tokens.name: vcr-line
tokens.usage: Default control border (fields, tiles, segmented). A hairline by intent: under 3:1, so state is never shown by border alone.

tokens.name: vcr-line-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button, chip, kbd and slider rail.

tokens.name: vcr-line-hover
tokens.usage: Border under the pointer; checkbox and swatch outlines.

tokens.name: vcr-line-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring and focused field border, 1px solid.

tokens.name: vcr-line-panel
tokens.usage: Edge of glass bars, panels and icon buttons.

tokens.name: vcr-line-divider
tokens.usage: Row dividers, group-header rules and the progress track.

tokens.name: vcr-fill-field
tokens.usage: Resting fill of fields, selects and status blocks.

tokens.name: vcr-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Fill under the pointer on unselected segments.

tokens.name: vcr-fill-active
tokens.usage: The row being edited.

tokens.name: vcr-fill-selected
tokens.usage: Selected chip and choice tile, always with a bone border.

tokens.name: vcr-fill-off
tokens.usage: The OFF cell of a switch while off.

tokens.name: vcr-signal
tokens.usage: Default status-mark colour.

tokens.name: vcr-signal-amber
tokens.usage: Optional accent for a 6px status square only. Never text, never a fill larger than the mark.

tokens.name: vcr-signal-phosphor
tokens.usage: Optional accent for a 6px status square only. Never text, never a fill larger than the mark.

tokens.name: vcr-surface-device
tokens.usage: Device and splash ground.

tokens.name: vcr-surface-app
tokens.usage: Opaque app surface where glass cannot blur anything.

tokens.name: vcr-action-primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per task.

tokens.name: vcr-action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary action under the pointer.

tokens.name: vcr-glass-bar
tokens.usage: Top bar, glass buttons, search pill and glass segmented controls.

tokens.name: vcr-glass-panel
tokens.usage: Trays, popovers and the mode bar.

tokens.name: vcr-glass-tip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: vcr-glass-sheet

tokens.name: vcr-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal sheet.

tokens.name: vcr-crop-surround
tokens.usage: Dims artwork outside the crop rectangle.

tokens.name: vcr-ground
tokens.usage: Flat app ground behind every glass surface. No imagery behind the UI.

tokens.name: vcr-desk
tokens.usage: Outside the app frame.

tokens.name: vcr-artboard-backing
tokens.usage: Opaque neutral behind artboards, tiles and crops so transparent or pale artwork reads.

tokens.name: vcr-placeholder
tokens.usage: Artwork not yet generated or not supplied. Theme-independent.

tokens.name: vcr-hatch-ink
tokens.usage: Dark stripe of the −45° hatch for imagery placeholders and failures.

tokens.name: vcr-hatch-light
tokens.usage: Light stripe of the −45° hatch.

tokens.name: vcr-ruler-tick
tokens.usage: 10% ticks under the ruler slider.

tokens.name: vcr-outline-light
tokens.usage: Inner stroke of a region outline and light label chips over artwork. Never themed.

tokens.name: vcr-outline-dark
tokens.usage: Outer stroke of a region outline and dark label chips over artwork. Never themed.

tokens.name: vcr-star-on
tokens.usage: Filled rating star.

tokens.name: vcr-star-off
tokens.usage: Empty rating star. Raised from the disabled step so an empty star holds 3:1.

styles.name: vcr-title
styles.usage: Screen titles. Specified at 300; Schibsted Grotesk has no 300, so it renders at 400.

styles.name: vcr-lead
